title: FemTheme Trio #035 · 여 라티나 커브스·군인 테마 / 여 사이렌 바스트 아워글래스·카우보이 테마 / 여 에이펙스 사이렌·소방관 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a wide pedestrian walkway on a large suspension bridge with a waist-high railing, standard lamp posts and the city skyline in daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, pure icy-white hair styled in a natural afro in a full rounded silhouette, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long rose-gold chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a bronze pyramid-shaped lump, a gold square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten silver anklets. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge and two silver dog-tag chains around her neck, a micro strapless camouflage-pattern bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal camouflage-pattern micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

CENTER: ONE real adult Chinese woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, bold vivid violet-purple hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver square-sided cowbell, a gold cube-shaped block, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a lead barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold miniature anvil, a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a copper teardrop-shaped sinker, an iron cube-shaped block, a lead round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked platinum hair ornaments. Extremely long square nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
CENTER Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
CENTER Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a brown leather cowboy hat, a red bandana knotted at her neck and a silver sheriff star pinned on a thin leather neck strap, a tiny brown leather micro-bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups on thin strings tied at the neck and back, fully covering her bust, and a minimal brown leather micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
CENTER Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body.
CENTER Footwear: Extreme silver needle heels with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

RIGHT: ONE real adult German woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, warm auburn red-brown hair styled in a short pixie cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large gold hoop carrying five heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a lead barrel-shaped weight, a gold miniature anvil, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a silver pyramid-shaped lump, a lead small flared temple bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long copper chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough silver a pyramid-shaped lump hanging at its end, and four to six layered mixed-metal bracelets. Extremely long square nails, holographic finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; not thin, not boyish, not evenly proportioned; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up and yellow reflective-striped cuffs on both wrists, a red silk scarf folded into the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and knotted in a small knot at the side of her bust right beside one breast, one end of the silk trailing long down her side and the other end cut short, fully opaque and covering only what it must, and a minimal red silk micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme hot-pink plain stiletto pumps with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
